title: Kenya's constitution says the Republic is a multi-party democratic state
summary: Kenya's constitution says the Republic is a multi-party democratic state.
body: The English text says the Republic of Kenya shall be a multi-party democratic state founded on the national values and principles of governance referred to in Article 10. The source says: "The Republic of Kenya shall be a multi-party democratic State founded on the national values and principles of governance referred to in Article 10." Multi-party democracy is stated, and the foundations are cross-referred to Article 10 rather than fully copied into this sentence.

sources.title: Constitution of Kenya, Constitute Project English text
